timing.queue: After predecessor first actual action, before independent predecessor ready; no artificial world pause.
timing.update: After original successor acceptance, before handoff; wait actual playback end + 0.5s when available.
timing.missing_receipt: Fail missing receipt check; after 15s, continue authored next turn only if intended state is still present and voice idle.
timing.missed_pending_window: Retain fixed denominator and record pending-window-unreached; no resampling, no forced pause, no pretend update.
timing.completion_during_update_audio: Record separately; judge actions against actual decisive-intent/authorization time, not unknowable future text.
timing.target_budget: A clock starts after U01; successor clock starts when A independently ready; updates do not reset A or total case budgets.
timing.handoff_clock: max(predecessor independently ready, final valid successor request fully available); do not start before request exists.
timing.predecessor_ready: Independent v2.5 native goal plus applicable release/support/stability checks; not Harness completed; endpoint hold is not an extra every-stage dwell.
timing.target_observation: Native success during the authorized task execution or within 40 simulation ticks after its last action, before any foreign task action and within wall/action budgets. Historical action-frame-only T1 scores remain separate.

scope: Current fixed-scene LIBERO-Goal goals0-9, not all LIBERO suites
whole_compound_predecessor: For goal3, cancellation only removes waiting wine bottle; opening top drawer AND placing bowl remains authorized.
physical_constraints: Original v2.5 including container-support evidence; no new positions, persistent constraints, closure, or threshold changes.
information_boundary: Target spec999; all goals derived from actually authorized user text in executor. No future test answers sent to agent.

time_grades.rule: Same trajectory; only handoff deadline changes. Missing handoff never passes solely by widening time.

provider_failure_policy: Stop scheduling on access/input-quality/infra failure, preserve attempts. At most one separately mapped retry allowed only if no benchmark WAV, no task and no policy action; never rerun real method failures.
scope_of_change: paths, packaging and discovery only; waveform/task/trigger/budgets/judge unchanged
